payload.entry:
Verified sase-1jx.12.1 against the child plan, parent phase sase-1jx.12 (tui-create), and the four closed phase notes. Commits 0defe76db8, 3dc675fffe, 1de7cf6c8d, and 241e33a797 implement the provider form, create Configure, danger Review/apply, and recovery plus the pinned Create row. Source review confirms lenient evaluate_repo_creation_form, 300ms off-thread probes, explicit add-instead, project.create durable submit, record_visibility_selection only after successful create (including dismissed-modal completion), mode-aware resume with Back restore, and Source n. Human-only create guard is unchanged. No feature flag and no glossary or human-only decision edits. sase bead epic-symbols sase-1jx.12.1, sase-1jx.12, and sase-1jx are empty; the sase-1jx.12(record_visibility_selection) row is gone. 165 focused create/add/resume/planning/cli/inventory tests passed. Import closure versus 0defe76db8^ is +0 modules.

Integration: non-epic commits since the epic started overlap only styles.tcss, in the Plan Review region, and the create danger rules landed after them. The apply-test split and the archive-pane retirement do not touch the wizard. No duplicate create path to rewire.

Follow-ups: declined _load_archive_bundle and the revival-preview assertion as already fixed (public load_archive_bundle in b249bc5e69; test_custom_search_preview_describes_archive_browsing passes) and noted that on sase-1jm. Declined the sase-1ju rule-7 flag lint because 101c853939 removed agents_archive_view from the flag registry. Corroborated the still-open import-budget failure on sase-1ic (+1; 3517 vs cap 3513, not grown by this epic) and the Project: fake/tmp header failures on sase-1k4 (+1; both tests still fail). Neither is caused by this epic.

Post-close cleanup after the 2026-10-12T18:20:05Z close. just symvision was red on test-only publics once this epic closed, so the landing diff privatizes this epic's create/resume helpers (_add_instead_seed, _build_create_plan_request, _create_identity_verdict, _create_review_request, _default_create_owner, _default_create_visibility, _lenient_effective_options, _probe_result_current, _supported_create_visibilities, _ResumeContext, _CreateRecovery) and the other unused publics the recipe still listed (plan-decision cards/rows, archive helpers, _validate_draft, _checkout_facts_from_source, _apply_identity_lock_path). Two create-flow tests used inline pilot.pause loops; both now use sase.ace.testing.wait.wait_for. just symvision then printed that all public/private classes and functions are used properly. Plan plan:202610/create_repository_wizard.md is status done. sase tool run check 33a35cb4c27e1fe5082745a546ca50e2 passed every lint stage, including symvision and test waits, then test (scoped) reported 5 failed / 55353 passed. Those five are pre-existing and not in this diff: the import budget is sase-1ic, the two Project header tests are sase-1k4, and test_dismissed_marker plus test_neighbors_map_shows_dismissed_revive_cells are a DISCOVERED ISSUE on sase-1jm (jump_opens_archive copy still says ▶ archive). The 11 plan-decision symbols are the ready task sase-1kd, closed as done by this diff. No epic-symbol rows remain for sase-1jx.12.1. Parent phase sase-1jx.12 stayed closed. Containing epic sase-1jx stays open.
